# awscc_dataexchange_data_set (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::DataExchange::DataSet



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN for the data set.
- `asset_type` (String) The type of asset that is added to a data set.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time that the data set was created, in ISO 8601 format.
- `data_set_id` (String) The unique identifier for the data set.
- `description` (String) A description for the data set.
- `name` (String) The name of the data set.
- `origin` (String) A property that defines the data set as OWNED by the account (for providers) or ENTITLED to the account (for subscribers).
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags for the data set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time that the data set was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)
